# Feima Copilot Documentation

> Technical documentation for the Feima Copilot VS Code extension — a model provider for GitHub Copilot Chat, a home for native Claude Code/Codex/Copilot CLI agent subscriptions, and a local LLM proxy for any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible tool. Bilingual (English + 中文), built with Astro Starlight.

## English Documentation

- [Home](https://docs.feimacode.com/): Documentation landing page with quick-start overview
- [Quick Start](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/quickstart/): Get Feima working with Copilot Chat in under 5 minutes
- [Installation](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/installation/): Installing the extension from the VS Code Marketplace
- [Authentication](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/authentication/): OAuth2 sign-in flow and account management
- [API Keys](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/api-keys/): Using Feima as a standalone API provider
- [Using Models](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/using-models/): Switching between AI models in Copilot Chat
- [Local & Enterprise Model Endpoints](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/local-endpoints/): Register your own Ollama/LM Studio/vLLM/enterprise gateway in the model picker, and route between them automatically with Feima Auto
- [Agent Participants](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/agent-participants/): Use the real Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot CLI agents from inside VS Code chat
- [Agent Participants Setup](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/agent-participants-setup/): Install and configure the Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot CLI agent participants
- [MCP Servers & Tools](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/agent-mcp-tools/): Control which MCP servers and VS Code tools are shared with the agent participants
- [Agent Proxy](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/agent-proxy/): How Feima Copilot routes Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot CLI through your Copilot or BYOK models
- [LLM Proxy](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/llm-proxy/): Use Feima's local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible proxy to drive any external tool with your Copilot or BYOK models
- [I Have a Claude Code Subscription](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/use-claude-code-subscription-in-vscode/): Use your existing Claude Pro/Max subscription with the real Claude Code agent inside VS Code
- [I Have a Codex Subscription](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/use-codex-subscription-in-vscode/): Use your existing ChatGPT/Codex subscription with the real Codex agent inside VS Code
- [Configuration](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/configuration/): Extension settings reference
- [Billing](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/billing/): Plans, credits, pay-per-use pricing
- [FAQ](https://docs.feimacode.com/guides/faq/): Frequently asked questions
